title: Beertii Habeenkii Baaba'day
intro: Bal qiyaas beer qurux badan, oo midhaha bislaaday ay ku hareeraysan yihiin geedo dhaadheer. Kuwa daryeela waxay isu maleeyeen inay yihiin kuwo caqli badan, iyagoo qorsheynaya goosashadooda saacadaha deggan ka hor waaberiga, iyagoo ka fog indhaha kuwa baahan. Laakiin Kan aan waligiis seexan wuxuu lahaa qorshayaal kale oo ku saabsan deeqsinimadooda qarsoon. Ma qiyaasi kartaa cidda ka dambeysa sheekadan digniinta ah ee Qur'aanka?
clues: Waxaan mar lahayn beer aad u qurux badan oo ay ku hinaastay dhammaan dadkii soo marayay.
Qorshaynteenna, waxaan isku af-garannay subaxdii hore, annagoo ku dhawaaqnay inaan qof baahan loo oggolaan doonin inuu soo galo maalintaas.
Waxaan ahayn dad hodan ah, qalbiyadeenuna way indho la'aayeen xuquuqda dadka saboolka ah ee nagu xeeran.
Markii waagii beerashada aan damacsanayn la gaaray, waxaan u soo dhawaannay beertayada oo habeen keliya isu beddeshay burbur madow.
Amar ba'an ayaa soo baxay, isagoo aan waxba ka reebin dambaskii ay rucubyo miro bisil ah mar la sudhnaayeen.
Sheekadeennu waa digniin adag oo ku qoran Qur'aanka, halkaas oo naloogu yaqaanno milkiilayaasha beerta ee sadaqada ka reebay kuwa baahan.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew. (68:33)
